item.title: David E. Anderson, former RNS editor and longtime journalist, dies at 84
item.description: ‘He was a legend by the time I got to meet him,’ said journalist Ira Rifkin of his future supervisor David Anderson. ‘He just seemed to know everything.’

item.title: Center for Congregations names Elise Erikson Barrett as President
New Jersey Catholic diocese agrees to $180 million settlement of clergy sexual abuse allegations
item.description: TRENTON, N.J. (AP) — It's the latest agreement in a scandal set off more than two decades ago when the scale of the abuse and the church's effort to hide it came to light in Boston.

item.title: Polish bishop on trial over alleged delays in reporting claims of child abuse by priests
item.description: It is the first time a Polish bishop is on trial over sexual abuse allegedly committed by priests under his authority.

item.title: How faith networks are building a safety net for immigrants released from detention
item.description: seekers arriving in U.S. cities, faith-based support networks are caring for immigrants after they’re released from stints in detention centers — a time when many lose housing and jobs.

item.title: Breakaway Catholic group rejects Vatican talks, indicating collision course for pope
item.description: Earlier this month, the SSPX announced it planned to consecrate four new bishops July 1.

item.title: An Ash Wednesday ‘mobilization’ showed us a way out of our country’s mess

item.title: Ash Wednesday protests and Masses make solidarity with immigrants a Lenten theme

item.title: In Boston, US Jews envision a Judaism beyond Zionism
item.description: At a ‘Jewish Left’ conference, attendees set out to build new institutions that they consider more ethically grounded in Judaism post-Oct. 7, 2023.
